case_number: 2024 INSC 358; CIVIL APPEAL NO. 3391 OF 2011, CIVIL APPEAL NO. 3849 OF 2011, CIVIL APPEAL NO. 3393 OF 2011, CIVIL APPEAL NO. 3394 OF 2011, CIVIL APPEAL NO. 3395 OF 2011

parties.respondent: The State of Rajasthan and Ors.

summary: Stamp duty levy jurisdiction on insurance policies; state competence under Entries 44 List III and 91 List I; Rajasthan Stamp Law (Adaptation) Act 1952 validity; insurance stamps procurement from other states; non-availability exception under Section 3A; High Court re-interpretation error; departmental procedure compliance; legislative competence upheld, but findings modified.
legal_provisions_cited: Constitution of India Entry 63 List II
final_judgment: Appeal partly allowed; certain High Court findings set aside; appellant granted relief in facts; state power to levy stamp duty affirmed.
